the electrophysiologic characteristics of subepicardially located muscle cells from the border zones of transmural infarcts in the canine heart.
the mechanisms of cardiac arrhythmias, particularly those occurring in the subepicadium and border zones of myocardial infarcts.
the study of the mechanisms of arrhythmias occurring at the border zones of myocardial infarcts.

, after infarction of the canine heart, the subepicardiial cells of the border zone may exhibit automaticity or triggered impulses, or both, and that the occurrence of these abnormal impulses may be related to the time interval after infarction.

in the subepicadial border zone of infarcts, the cells have a tendency toward triggered activity and/or automaticity.
